integrity: The exact claim is supported by ordered-time cumulant integration and strict stochastic ordering of a positive span distribution; 395 deterministic verification checks were executed on the attached independent moment ODE and quadrature program.
limitations: Isotropic complete velocity renewal at exponential times only; noninteracting planar motion; stationary initial mark and finite fourth speed moment. The sign of a fourth-moment statistic does not characterize all probability tails, and the presence of a fresh heading is essential. No claim of first-priority or independent assessment.
title: A unique kurtosis-sign crossover for runwise speed renewal in planar active motion
